Identification

Assay of
Tamsulosin
Hydrochloride

The actual manufacturer (as per label claim) has
declared the impugned batch to be not
manufactured by them and that it is a spurious
drug. After enquiry, Joint Investigation Team of
CDSCO (East Zone), CDSCO (Goa Sub Zone)
and SLA (Goa) have declared the said drug as
spurious u/s 17B(e) of Drugs & Cosmetics Act,
1940, however, the same is subject to outcome
of further investigation.
